subsystems.title: Input actions
subsystems.why: the action and binding vocabulary is frozen; the raw per-frame state under it is Beta — see InputState
subsystems.whyZh: 动作与绑定的词汇表已冻结；它下面的每帧原始状态是 Beta —— 见 InputState

subsystems.title: Raw input state
subsystems.why: per-frame touch state is reachable only as raw collections, with no accessor for started/ended and no write door — freezing it would freeze both gaps
subsystems.whyZh: 每帧触摸状态只能通过原始集合拿到，started/ended 没有访问器，也没有写入门 —— 冻结它等于把这两个缺口一起冻进去

subsystems.title: UI
subsystems.why: thirty-three of a hundred and fifteen UI symbols reach a certified game, and the newest part of the surface is the part a creator meets first — anchors, insets, theme tokens
subsystems.whyZh: 115 个 UI 符号里只有 33 个到得了被认证的游戏，而这套面最新的部分恰恰是创作者最先碰的：锚点、inset、主题 token

subsystems.title: Scenes
subsystems.why: one certified project drives scenes at all, against twenty-six SceneManagerState signatures
subsystems.whyZh: 只有一个被认证的项目在驱动场景，而 SceneManagerState 有 26 个签名

subsystems.title: Prefabs
subsystems.why: instantiate has not moved, but its result and override shapes are the on-disk format's, so the names settled ahead of the shapes
subsystems.whyZh: instantiate 没有动过，但它的结果和覆盖形状属于磁盘格式，所以名字比形状先定下来

subsystems.title: Assets
subsystems.why: one certified project takes Res(Assets), for four of its members, and the host wiring — resolvers, registries, the manifest, device-loss recovery — has to leave the game-facing surface first
subsystems.whyZh: 只有一个被认证的项目用 Res(Assets)，且只用了 4 个成员；而宿主接线（resolver、registry、manifest、设备丢失恢复）必须先离开面向游戏的这一面

subsystems.title: Physics
subsystems.why: the corpus reaches three of thirty-seven physics symbols
subsystems.whyZh: 语料只触到 37 个物理符号里的 3 个

subsystems.title: Camera
subsystems.why: clearFlags is a bitmask whose C++ enum has no TypeScript spelling, and cullingMask names layers no exported constant identifies — two fields typed `number` for want of the vocabulary
subsystems.whyZh: clearFlags 是位掩码，而它的 C++ enum 在 TypeScript 侧没有拼写；cullingMask 指的图层没有任何导出常量能标识 —— 两个字段被打成 number 是因为缺词汇

subsystems.title: Spine
subsystems.why: one certified project plays a skeleton; the runtime is a side module a project opts into
subsystems.whyZh: 只有一个被认证的项目在播骨骼；运行时是项目自行选用的 side module

subsystems.title: Audio
subsystems.why: a certified run drives a loop and reads the master bus analyser, so a break is noticed — but the corpus reaches a handful of twenty-three audio symbols
subsystems.whyZh: 已有被认证的运行会驱动一个循环并读取 master 总线的 analyser，所以它坏了会被发现——但语料只触到 23 个音频符号里的少数几个

subsystems.title: Animation & timeline
subsystems.why: sprite-animation now certifies it end to end, but the corpus reaches two of eighty animation symbols and the timeline half of them is untouched
subsystems.whyZh: sprite-animation 现在端到端认证了它，但语料只触到 80 个动画符号里的 2 个，而其中时间轴那一半完全没被碰过

subsystems.title: Tilemap
subsystems.why: two games certify it and one of them runs on every change, which is broader evidence than several rows already at this tier; what is not settled is the multi-tileset layer, whose singular field is still carried for older scenes
subsystems.whyZh: 两个游戏认证了它，其中一个每次改动都跑 —— 这比几个已经在这一级的子系统证据还多；还没定下来的是多 tileset 的图层，单数字段仍为旧场景保留着

subsystems.title: Particles
subsystems.why: one certified game drives it, the same evidence spine and scene were published on; the authored curves are the young half — they override the start/end pairs, and only one game has authored any
subsystems.whyZh: 有一个被认证的游戏在驱动它，与 spine、scene 当初发布时的证据同级；年轻的那一半是可编辑曲线 —— 它们会覆盖 start/end，而只有一个游戏真的编过

subsystems.title: Video
subsystems.why: the platform paths differ enough that the surface is still converging
subsystems.whyZh: 各平台路径差异仍大，这套面还在收敛

subsystems.title: AI — navigation, FSM, behaviour trees
subsystems.titleZh: AI —— 导航、状态机、行为树
subsystems.why: deliberately after the rest: 0.50 freezes what a game is built OUT of, and the layers built ON that come once those are settled
subsystems.whyZh: 刻意排在后面：0.50 冻的是「一个游戏由什么构成」，建立在其上的层要等下面这些定下来

subsystems.title: Networking & replication
subsystems.why: as AI — the high-level layer waits on the layers under it
subsystems.whyZh: 同 AI —— 高层要等它下面的层

subsystems.title: Materials, lighting, post-processing
subsystems.why: as AI — a game is built OUT of the layers under this one and they freeze first; the render graph it was waiting on has settled
subsystems.whyZh: 同 AI —— 一个游戏是由它下面那几层构成的,那些先冻;它当初等的那个 render graph 已经定下来了

subsystems.title: 3D physics
subsystems.why: its door — the plugin, the world resource, the contact events — reached no entry until this release, so nothing has yet built on the half a game actually calls
subsystems.whyZh: 它的门（插件、世界资源、碰撞事件）到这个版本才第一次进入口，所以游戏真正会调用的那一半还没有被任何东西建立在上面

subsystems.title: 3D models & skinning
subsystems.why: the import chain is certified end to end, but the runtime surface a game drives a model through — geometry, materials per submesh, joint entities — has not been read for a tier
subsystems.whyZh: 导入链路已经端到端认证，但游戏用来驱动模型的运行时面（几何体、逐子网格材质、关节实体）还没有被拿来定级

subsystems.title: DragonBones
subsystems.why: the second 2D skeletal runtime, and the one no certified game animates with — Spine carries that evidence and this shares none of it
subsystems.whyZh: 第二个 2D 骨骼运行时，也是没有任何被认证的游戏在用的那个 —— 证据在 Spine 那边，这边一点也没分到

subsystems.title: Math
subsystems.why: the TYPES are frozen — Vec2, Vec3, Quat are @public and a Transform is made of them — but the operations over them are not, and a verdict has to name the weaker half
subsystems.whyZh: 类型本身已冻结 —— Vec2、Vec3、Quat 是 @public，Transform 就是由它们构成的 —— 但它们之上的运算没有，而判决必须按更弱的那一半来说

subsystems.title: Localization
subsystems.why: certified end to end by one game, whose use is a locale and a key lookup; the plural, formatting and fallback surface around that has no consumer
subsystems.whyZh: 有一个游戏端到端认证了它，但用到的只是「切语言 + 查 key」；围绕它的复数、格式化、回退这一圈没有任何消费者

subsystems.title: Platform services
subsystems.why: each service is a contract with a store rather than with the engine, and the ones behind it differ enough that the shared shape is still being found
subsystems.whyZh: 每个服务都是与某个平台的契约而非与引擎的契约，而它们之间的差异大到共同形状还没找出来
